rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Deathstrike
rules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.

rules.name: Decimate
rules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Infected
rules.description: If this model has Infected, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Infected (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Infected Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Infected. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Violent
rules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Fast Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Fortified Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

rules.name: Infected
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

rules.name: No Retreat
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

rules.name: No Retreat Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get No Retreat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precision Growth
rules.description: Place one token on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Thrust
rules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

rules.name: Thrust in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Thrust on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
rules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

rules.name: Violent
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

spells.name: Bio-Horror
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.

spells.name: Brain Infestation
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Rapid Mutation
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Spread Plague
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Decimate.

spells.name: Violent Onslaught
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Infected once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Volatile Infection
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3).
